section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section details the findings of the present study, focusing on the psychometric properties of the Portuguese ACSS and BAS among Brazilian adults. It confirms a three-factor structure for the ACSS and a two-factor structure for the BAS, discusses convergent validity, and notes few significant sex differences in cosmetic surgery acceptance. The section also addresses study limitations, including sample size disparities and lack of socioeconomic data.
